SWISS-MONO FONT SUBSET MANIFEST
===============================

Source of truth for tests/test_swiss_fonts.py: the vendored woff2 cmaps must
match this exactly. Separate from the HUD's manifest because the sets differ
and each test parses a single --unicodes= line.

Fonts (SIL OFL 1.1, licenses alongside):
  Inter          400/600/700/800  -> inter-{400,600,700,800}.woff2
  JetBrains Mono 500/700          -> jetbrains-mono-{500,700}.woff2
Weights are the ones design-mocks/swiss-mono.html uses.

Upstreams:
  Inter - google/fonts ofl/inter/Inter[opsz,wght].ttf (variable)
  JetBrains Mono - JetBrains/JetBrainsMono fonts/ttf/{Medium,Bold}.ttf

Regeneration:
  Inter is variable, so instance each weight to a static master first:
    fontTools.varLib.instancer  ->  wght=<W>, opsz=14
  then subset every face identically:

  --unicodes=U+0020-007E,U+00B0,U+00B7,U+2191,U+2193,U+25CF
  --flavor=woff2 --layout-features='tnum' --no-hinting --desubroutinize

  'tnum' (tabular figures), not '*': Inter's full feature set pulls in its
  alternate glyphs and makes the files ~10x larger. Only the cmap is pinned.

Characters: Basic Latin (U+0020-007E), ° (U+00B0), · (U+00B7),
↑ (U+2191, "+N earlier"), ↓ (U+2193, "+N more"), ● (U+25CF, "● NOW").
All are present in both fonts, so no SVG fallback is needed.
